title: Breeze block screen wall with see-through openings
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps with alpha of a breeze block screen wall: stacked concrete or clay blocks with mortar joints and cut-out openings (circles, quatrefoils, diamonds, flowers or a grille), darkened inner walls and weathering. Use for mid-century facades, garden screens and balconies.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python breeze_block_screen.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: motif
parameters.meaning: Opening cut in each block: 0 a circle with four small corner circles, 1 a quatrefoil, 2 a diamond with four corner triangles, 3 a four-petal flower around a solid centre, 4 a grille of nine square holes.

parameters.name: blocks_across
parameters.meaning: Blocks across the tile width (and height).

parameters.name: frame
parameters.meaning: Solid rim between the block edge and its openings, in block widths.

parameters.name: opening_scale
parameters.meaning: Size of the opening motif within the rim.

parameters.name: joint_width
parameters.meaning: Mortar joint between blocks in block widths; 0 butts the blocks together.

parameters.name: bevel
parameters.meaning: Rounded edge of the concrete around openings and joints, in block widths.

parameters.name: weathering
parameters.meaning: Stains, streaks and grime on the concrete.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: White painted blocks with a large circle and four small ones, mid-century style.

presets.name: quatrefoil_cream
presets.description: Cream concrete quatrefoil blocks, three per side.

presets.name: raw_diamond
presets.description: Raw grey concrete diamond blocks with pores and rain streaks.

presets.name: terracotta_flower
presets.description: Terracotta clay flower blocks, butted with thin joints.

presets.name: pastel_grille
presets.description: Pastel green blocks with nine square holes each.

limits: The openings are alpha cut-outs on a flat card: the block depth is only suggested by darkening near the openings and the height map, so the see-through view does not shift with the viewing angle as real block walls do. Blocks are stacked in a square grid; running bond and half blocks are out of scope. Motifs are fixed signed-distance shapes, not catalogue designs. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Signed distance unions and intersections of circles, ellipses, boxes and half-planes for opening motifs
Alpha from the opening distance, anti-aliased over one pixel
Stack-bond square grid with mortar joint distance
Per-block hashing for colour and tone
Fractional Brownian motion for stains and streaks
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
